pages.text: What the Hollow's creatures leave behind is not only for magic. A builder can make a home of it: lamps of living crystal, lanterns with a wisp caught inside, dark woven cloth, and the silver scales of the Lurkers laid as tiles.
A crystal cluster that glows as bright as glowstone.
Hangs from a ceiling or stands on the floor, like any lantern.
Woven Shade Cloth, soft and dark.
Silver scale tiles. Slabs and stairs are made the usual way.
